h1: FIG Boutique Hotel — a small in-town boutique, easy on the wallet, near the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park
intro: If you want a place in central Kamphaeng Phet that's easy on the wallet, with spacious rooms and close to the Historical Park, the name budget travellers keep coming back to is FIG Boutique Hotel · a small boutique hotel of around 27 rooms down a quiet lane in town, with spacious rooms, cold AC, balconies, flat-screen TVs and fridges, free parking and free Wi-Fi, a restaurant and breakfast on offer · real-guest score around 7.3. What reviews mention most is how cheap it is, how roomy it feels for the price, the friendly staff and the quiet. The trade-offs are that it sits down a fairly deep lane that's tricky to find at first, and a few reviews flag cleanliness issues in some rooms. Rooms start at around ฿550/night (sometimes with breakfast included).

body.html: FIG Boutique Hotel is a small boutique hotel of around 27 rooms tucked down a quiet lane in central Kamphaeng Phet, open since around 2013 · it positions itself as a simple, wallet-friendly stay that leans on cleanliness and spacious rooms rather than fancy facilities · most guests are budget travellers, people visiting the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, and road-trippers driving between Bangkok and Chiang Mai who want an affordable place to overnight in town · the things reviews praise most are the value and the friendly, helpful staff.

The main room types are Standard Twin and Standard Double, around 20 sqm · the most common praise is that rooms feel bigger than expected for the price, the AC is cold, the beds are comfortable, there's a balcony, and everything is clean enough at this price point · many reviews call it simple but great value, ideal for anyone who just wants a good room for very little money · the trade-off to know up front is that it's an older hotel with plain decor, not luxurious, and a few reviews ran into cleanliness issues in certain rooms, such as a musty smell or marks in the bathroom · overall it stands out for price and room size rather than for being new or design-led.
"Clean, spacious and very cheap, the staff are lovely and helpful, breakfast was included and parking was easy. It's quiet and brilliant value for visiting the Historical Park."

Facilities are what you'd expect from a small in-town hotel · there's a Thai restaurant, a café, free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage and breakfast (sometimes included in the rate, sometimes charged separately — check when you book) · rooms come with AC, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, free drinking water and a rainfall shower · the limitation reviews mention is that there's no pool or gym, and being an older property you have to accept it isn't brand new · but for the price, many guests say they got more than they paid for.

The location is right in Kamphaeng Phet town · it's about 5 minutes' drive to the Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, close to the town markets, restaurants and convenience stores · the thing to keep in mind is that the hotel sits down a fairly deep lane — several reviews say it's a little hard to find the first time, so keep your map navigation open · the upside of the deep lane is that it's quiet and parking is easy · it suits people driving their own car or anyone wanting an affordable in-town base within walking distance of food · the overall score sits around 7.3 from real reviews across several platforms, which is good for a budget hotel.

To be straight with you, FIG Boutique Hotel is a small, wallet-friendly hotel in town, not a luxe boutique or a resort with a pool · it's an older property with plain decor, down a lane that's hard to find, and a few reviews flag cleanliness in some rooms · if you're expecting something brand new, design-heavy, or with a pool, it won't be your pick · but if you're after a spacious, clean-enough room at a low price, in town and near the Historical Park, with friendly staff and easy parking — it does the job well and is genuinely good value.

A tip from reading through the reviews here: open your map navigation before you arrive, because the hotel sits down a deep lane that's hard to find the first time · ask to see the room first, or request a well-ventilated one, to avoid any that might smell musty · check at booking whether the rate includes breakfast, as it varies by period · having your own car is most convenient, with free parking on site · and always compare the price directly on Agoda and Trip.com before booking, as rates shift with the season and promotions.
